title: Mousse au Chocolat
description: A traditional France dish made with heavy cream, pasteurized egg whites. This home-style preparation follows its characteristic cooking method and uses measured ingredients.

steps.instruction: Melt chocolate gently over a barely simmering water bath together with a splash of cream, stirring smooth; cool to lukewarm.
Whisk or whip the listed ingredients to a smooth, light consistency, then keep cool until needed.
Fold lightly whipped cream into cooled melted chocolate, then gently fold in pasteurized whipped egg whites to make an airy mousse; portion into serving dishes.
Cool the prepared ingredients promptly, then refrigerate for about 150 minutes until properly chilled.
